name: Comprehensiveness
description: The extent to which the summary covers the essential points of the source document, including the background, methodology, results, and conclusions.

name: Clarity
description: The degree to which the summary is presented in a logical and coherent manner, making it easy to understand and follow.

name: Accuracy
description: The extent to which the summary correctly represents the information in the source document, without introducing errors or misinterpretations.

name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the summary focuses on the most important aspects of the source document, as determined by the context and purpose of the assessment.

name: Conciseness
description: The ability of the summary to convey the essential information of the source document in a succinct and efficient manner.
